Builder on the CI runner stopped picking up jobs after the upgrade. Output of
docker buildx ls from the runner:

NAME/NODE                DRIVER/ENDPOINT                   STATUS    BUILDKIT   PLATFORMS
ci-builder*              docker-container
 \_ ci-builder0           \_ unix:///var/run/docker.sock   running   v0.30.0    linux/amd64

Recreating the builder with --bootstrap fixed it.
